name: meeting_tagging
description: Laya decision router schema for classifying meeting types based on transcript overview

questions.question: Is this meeting a daily standup, sync, or status report covering yesterday, today, and blockers?
Is this meeting an engineering sprint planning, architecture review, or roadmap milestone sync?
Is this meeting a private 1-on-1 between a manager and direct report or two peers?
Is this meeting an external sales presentation, customer discovery, or client demo?
Is this meeting a company-wide town hall, executive address, or all-hands meeting?
